title: PRE-RAID PAGE REBUILT AS DESIGN A, MAP FIRST: AN ICE BLUE MAP, CONDITIONS BESIDE IT, KIT AND PACK AND ASCEND PLATE IN THE RIGHT COLUMN, ONE PRESS ON A PAD
why: His pick of 2026-10-19: "por-raid redesing -- i pick A, but give the map some different color so it breaks up the monotny/overwhelmingness of the screen". The old page was a debug panel (critic 2): a small grey map in a brown banner, five rows of equal weight, a full-width bar to ascend and about 41 pad stops. The map now takes two thirds of the page in ice blue drawn from the real map data, the conditions list sits beside it with xp badges, the right column holds the kit tiles, a grouped pack with one stepper per row, the going-up chips and a big ascend plate, and the pad opens on ascend with LB and RB jumping between panels.
now: The pre-raid page is rebuilt: a big ice blue map of cold storage with its zones, exits and keyed rooms, conditions beside it, and the kit, pack and ascend button in a column on the right. On a pad you press A once to go up.
